scope: what decides a level besides the seed: the save file, the difficulty, the curses
finding: with one run seed, character and difficulty, two games generate the same level and the same curse only from the same persistent game data; mods (all disabled) and difficulty were ruled out

persistentGameData.readOnlyFlag: byte +1 of the object, Manager+0x15; 1 in every seeded run observed
persistentGameData.fileNames: persistentgamedata<slot>.dat in the profile folder; rep+persistentgamedata<slot>.dat in Steam Cloud, same format

gameFields.difficulty: Game+0x269c8, 0 normal, 1 hard, 2 greed, 3 greedier (Lua getter RVA 0x19e290; Game::IsGreedMode RVA 0x2f8120 reads the same field)
gameFields.levelCurses: Level+0xc with the level at the head of the game object, bit 0 Darkness .. bit 7 Giant (Level::GetCurses RVA 0x348490 also ors Game+0x26550 and two adjustments)

officialOnline.note: read statically from the log strings' users, nothing here was called
officialOnline.matchStart: sets the save read-only, starts the game (0x2f8140), restores the flag, places the players, then loads shared state from a buffer (0x2f6500, pointer and size), checks player count against remote players, binds players to controllers and colours
officialOnline.participantSaves: container at Manager+0x4b414 keyed by Manager+0x4c5a8; the desync report (RVA 0x503040, 0x5032d0) prints four shared save user ids and dumps desync_shared_save.dat
officialOnline.sharedSaveIsAnIntersection: first-hand account of the user, not read from the binary: what any lobby member has not unlocked appears for nobody, and the shop's level and donated coins adjust the same way; there is no joining a run in progress

validation.sameSaveSameLevel: 0 of 15 rooms differ, same Curse of Darkness
validation.liveRoomTransitionThroughFormerlyDiverge: right door 84 -> 85, 7 of 7 enemies matched in 208 of 208 frames

runState.file: gamestate<slot>.dat in the profile folder, rep+gamestate<slot>.dat in Steam Cloud, header ISAACNG_GSR0169, about 57 KB; the file behind the menu's Continue
runState.writtenAt: run start, a new floor, Exit game
runState.loadsOnlyBeside: the persistent game data it was saved with
runState.object: embedded in Manager at +0xfa4; file name at Manager+0x20d60
runState.saveNow: no arguments, works through the global Manager; checks itself that a run is on (Manager+8 == 2), that it is no daily (Game+0x26630 == 0), that there are no network devices and that the player is alive; never called by this project
runState.gameSaveStateNote: called by saveNow with Manager+0xfa4; settles REPENTOGON's ambiguous signature (0x2f9000, not 0x512b60)
runState.playerCounters: Entity_Player: maxHearts 0x1340, redHearts 0x1344, eternalHearts 0x1348, soulHearts 0x134c, blackHearts 0x1350, keys 0x135c, bombs 0x1364, coins 0x1368 - the same offsets as REPENTOGON's J273 layout; the +0xc shift of J460 starts later

validation.joinedFromFiles: a fourth instance started from copies of the save and the run state entered the run through Continue: seed, floor, difficulty, curse, all 15 rooms, visit counts, hearts, keys, coins and the spent bomb (0 against 1 in a fresh run) agree, game time carried over
validation.playerPlaceNotInFile: Continue puts the player at a door, a different one in each of two games
validation.fullPipelineWithJoinedClient: stepped prediction between two isolated instances, 449 of 449 commands, error 0 on 406 reconciliations, players 0.0 and 0.0 apart at the end

fileFormat.layout: 16-byte header ISAACNGSAVE09R, one word the loader stores unchecked (object +0xf84), chunks of (type, size word, element count, elements), the bestiary (chunk 11, variable), a closing checksum
fileFormat.chunks: 1 achievements 642 x u8, 2 counters 523 x u32, 3 level counters 14 x u32, 4 collectibles 733 x u8, 5 minibosses 7 x u8, 6 bosses 104 x u8, 7 challenges 46 x u8, 8 cutscene counters 27 x u32, 9 game settings 2 x u32, 10 special seed counters 80 x u8; chunks 1-10 end at byte 4016; the size word is four times the count except for chunk 1
fileFormat.checksum: over bytes [16, length-4): CRC-32 polynomial 0xEDB88320 with the game's own table, built with one logical and seven arithmetic right shifts, seed 0xFEDCBA76 inverted before and after; stored in the last four bytes
fileFormat.verifiedOn: a hundred real J460 saves (92 session dumps, 7 isolated instances, the Steam Cloud file), byte-exact parse and rebuild
fileFormat.bestiary: chunk 11: header (type, 4 * total entries, map count 4), then maps (number, 4 * entries, entries of key i32 and value u32) stored in the order 4, 2, 3, 1 with entries in ascending key order; a 4-byte word follows before the checksum

lobbySave.source: read from the game's own builder, not approximated

gameFlow.hostStart: Menu_OnlineLobby::send_game_start 0x4ee080 -> 0x50c560 (members' saves from the map at netmanager+0x1068) -> builder 0x51a450
gameFlow.clientLoad: Notify Game Start handler 0x50ca40 -> deserializer 0x51adf0 over Manager+0x14; what the shared save lacks stays the player's own

rule.flags: achievements, collectibles, minibosses, bosses, challenges: bitwise AND over the members
rule.counters: 523 counters and 14 level counters: unsigned minimum
rule.bestiary: maps 1 and 2: per key the minimum, a key missing in any member is erased
rule.notShared: game settings, special seed counters, bestiary maps 3 and 4; here they come from the first save, the host's

wireForm.order: achievements, counters, collectibles, level counters, minibosses, bosses, cutscene counters, challenges, bestiary map 1, map 2, four member ids
wireForm.flags: one bit each, least significant first, in (count >> 3) + 1 bytes (packer 0x51b580, reader 0x51b650): 104 bosses take 14 bytes
wireForm.maps: u32 count, then entries of key i32 and value u32

writeBack.counters: own += max(0, shared at the end - shared at the start), bestiary maps 1 and 2 alike
writeBack.keptOwn: 36 counters (114, 115, 159-172, 212, 385-403) and 12 achievements (242-251, 275, 341) are copied from the player's own save into both checkpoint copies (0x51b720)
writeBack.validation: 31 sessions of the local player: all flags, bestiary and about 515 of 523 counters reproduce exactly; 1-6 elements per session differ - counters 21 and 497-520 and cutscene counters, which the game changes in the real save directly

sessionDumps.sharedsave_begin: the shared save at the match start
sessionDumps.sharedsave_end: its state at the last checkpoint
sessionDumps.persistentgamedata_begin: not the save before the session: a copy of the live data at write-back time, the shared context at the end
sessionDumps.persistentgamedata_end: the player's real save after the write-back
sessionDumps.caveat: the game writes the shared save dumps from buffers it has already released: 20 of 92 hold other memory, and the first four bytes of a surviving one may be a heap link

validation.startSharedSaveWithinRealSave: 32 of 38; 3 differ only in the first four dump bytes (heap pointers), 2 are sessions with two match starts, 1 is an eden token spent by playing Eden
validation.notPossible: byte equality with the game's shared save: the other members' saves are not available
validation.live: first version of the tool, progressed + clean save: accepted by the game (no checksum warning, locked characters, win streak 0) and gave the clean save's level: 0 of 15 rooms differ from the clean-save game, no curse; 5 rooms and the curse differ from the host

friendsCopies.firstFriend: a real save written at the end of a session: all 17 earlier shared saves fit within it as well as within the local player's save (one element above: counter 497 in one session)
friendsCopies.secondFriend: not a save but the shared context of a running session (14 elements from the local player's live data at the end of that session); guess: the game was quit mid-session and wrote its live data to the normal file - on the local machine the normal file was never written during any of 44 sessions
friendsCopies.byteEquality: not reached: no copy was taken right before a session whose members' saves are all known; closest case differs in 4 of about 2600 elements, all in the expected direction

oneStepLobby.validation: user's save (90 achievements) and a friend's copy (223) share 86; two instances from the one merged file accepted it (no checksum complaint), typed seed CZH4 8E6W, hard: 0 of 15 rooms differ, same curse; the full stepped-prediction coop pipeline passed on the pair (449 of 449 commands, prediction error 0 over 406 reconciliations, no teleport, hooks restored)

lobbyProcess.states: open -> started (membership frozen, tickets out) -> running (every game proved equal) | aborted
lobbyProcess.memberSends: the packed shared part of the save (isaac_save.encode_shared), never the file
lobbyProcess.memberPlaysFrom: isaac_save.overlay: the shared save over the member's own, as the game does at Notify Game Start; settings, special seeds, bestiary maps 3-4 stay the member's
lobbyProcess.liveSaveFlags: PersistentGameData at Manager+0x14: achievements +0x38, collectibles +0xae8, minibosses +0xe00, bosses +0xe07, challenges +0xe6f (offsets of the game's deserializer RVA 0x51adf0)
lobbyProcess.proof: seed, difficulty, isaac_level.fingerprint of the generated level, SHA-256 of the live save's flags; the host's own game is held to the same
lobbyProcess.validation: 10 unit tests incl. TCP; real host and member processes on loopback with the running lobby pair: go; latecomer refused 'started'; a guest save the games were not started from -> abort with both members' flags differing; gate refuses swapped games and an aborted match
lobbyProcess.notYet: live pass on fresh instances with --launch; in-process overlay through the game's own deserializer; the ticket's session as the modules' session
